products.name: Luxury Bath Gel
products.description: A gentle bath and shower gel for a relaxing self-care routine.

accordion.details: Formulated with nourishing botanical extracts, this gentle bath and shower gel cleanses without stripping the skin, leaving it soft, calm, and lightly scented. Suitable for daily use.
accordion.ingredients: Aqua, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Botanical Extract Blend, Fragrance, Citric Acid, Sodium Chloride, Phenoxyethanol.

products.name: Luxury Bath Oil
products.description: A soothing bath oil created to leave your skin feeling soft.

accordion.details: A rich, silky bath oil that disperses into warm water to soften and nourish the skin. Ideal for an indulgent evening soak, leaving skin smooth and lightly fragranced.
accordion.ingredients: Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Fragrance, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Limonene.

products.name: Luxury Mini Bath Bombs (12 Pack, 6 Scents)
products.description: A set of 12 mini bath bombs across 6 fragrances, each one fizzing into a colourful, indulgent soak.

accordion.details: Drop one into warm water and watch it fizz into a fragrant, colourful soak enriched with moisturising oils. Comes as a set of 12 mini bath bombs across 6 fragrances — a playful, indulgent addition to any self-care routine.
accordion.ingredients: Sodium Bicarbonate, Citric Acid, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Fragrance, Colorant, Sodium Laureth Sulfate.

products.name: Luxury Bath Salt
products.description: Mineral bath salts designed for a calm and indulgent soak.

accordion.details: Enriched with natural mineral salts and lavender essential oil, this calming blend transforms your bath into a soothing, detoxifying ritual. Sprinkle generously under warm running water.
accordion.ingredients: Maris Sal (Sea Salt), Magnesium Sulfate, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Oil, Fragrance, Colorant.

products.name: Luxury Bath Sponge
products.description: A soft cleansing sponge designed to create a rich lather.

accordion.details: A soft, gentle konjac sponge designed to work your favourite CyRamage bath gel into a rich, luxurious lather while lightly exfoliating the skin. Naturally biodegradable and gentle enough for daily use.

products.name: Luxury Bath Tea
products.description: A botanical bath blend for a peaceful and comforting experience.

accordion.details: A botanical bath tea blend of dried flowers and herbs, steeped directly in your bathwater for a peaceful, comforting soak. Each pouch contains reusable bath tea bags.
accordion.ingredients: Chamomilla Recutita (Chamomile) Flower, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Flower, Rosa Damascena (Rose) Petals, Calendula Officinalis Flower.

products.name: Flower Candle — Pink Peony (4 Pack)
products.description: Beautifully hand-crafted flower candles that bring warmth, elegance and a soft glow to any space. Designed to look as beautiful unlit as it does burning, this 4-pack is perfect for bathrooms, bedrooms, living rooms, and gift boxes.

accordion.details: Hand-poured in a premium soy wax blend with an elegant flower design. Clean, long-lasting burn of approximately 25–35 hours per candle. Cotton wick. Net wt. (each) approx. 50g / 1.76oz — total net wt. 200g / 7.05oz.
